name: n8n-autonomous-agent
description: Capstone C — an autonomous agent that, given an inbound signal, AUTONOMOUSLY decides which portfolio tools to invoke (support-triage / product-feedback / rag / eval / drift) via the signed interaction-gateway, observes each result, and produces a consolidated outcome — under guardrails (refusal / tool-allowlist / max-steps / no-fabricated-result). Graded by agent-trajectory evals; the SAME rubric grades the deterministic stub planner AND a live LLM (the non-deterministic-agent eval thesis A+D were built to de-risk). v0.1.0: pure agent core + offline trajectory eval (verify:agent 39/39); the SDK workflow + live LLM/gateway are the next increments.
